content:
Synthetic division of \(a^4+4a^3+6a^2-3a-6\) by \(a+1\):

\[
\begin{array}{r|rrrrr}
-1 & 1 & 4 & 6 & -3 & -6 \\
   &   & -1 & -3 & -3 & 6 \\
\hline
   & 1 & 3 & 3 & -6 & 0
\end{array}
\]

So
\[
a^4+4a^3+6a^2-3a-6=(a+1)(a^3+3a^2+3a-6).
\]

Thus the original polynomial factors as
\[
(a+1)^2(a^3+3a^2+3a-6)=0.
\]

Since \(a\neq -1\), we have
\[
a^3+3a^2+3a-6=0.
\]

But
\[
a^3+3a^2+3a-6=(a+1)^3-7.
\]

Therefore
\[
(a+1)^3-7=0 \implies (a+1)^3=7.
\]

\[
\boxed{7}
\]
